correctness.rationale: Every admissible subset contains no independent four-set, so its size is at most 6 by bipartite parity. Fresh independent enumeration gives augmented face counts 1416 and 3642. The record vertex orders produce acyclic complete Hasse matchings with 20 and 56 unmatched five-simplices and an empty-face pairing, leaving one geometric critical 0-cell. Since no other cells remain, Forman gives integral wedges of 20 and 56 five-spheres. Independent complete Hasse sort verifies acyclicity, with 6160 and 16470 incidences.
residual_risks: Finite complete cases only; no all-grid conjecture proved.

A separately generated matching order and re-enumerated counts are alternative certificates, not new structural content.
